frequency_question: How often do structural frictions successfully block or prevent the implementation of announced central bank liquidity management tools within the specified window once initiated?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a central bank proposed or implemented specialized reserve-locking mechanisms or extraordinary liquidity absorption tools; excludes routine open market operations.

cases.name: PBoC RRR Cut and Liquidity Tool Deployment

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; comprehensive for major emerging market central bank regulatory liquidity mandates.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative delays that did not stop the ultimate implementation within the window.
skeleton: Central bank extraordinary liquidity regulatory interventions across major jurisdictions over the past decade.
multiplier: 3 observed successful deployments / 3 total attempted deployments within similar structural friction contexts
validity_reason: Central bank operational frameworks and autonomous regulatory powers regarding reserve requirements remain stable over multi-year horizons.
